arc: Add exception for symlink blocking on stateful. Symlink and FIFO access on the stateful partition are being blocked by CL:978780 for security reasons. We need to add an exception to this policy so that ARC++ can use symlinks in /mnt/stateful_partition/unencrypted/art-data to make host compiled code available in ARC++ container without copying. See b/75023589 for details. BUG=b:75023589 TEST=ran Android CTS tests that used to reliably trigger symlink blocking for cache file. Symlink traversal is no longer blocked. Change-Id: I5056f5485d93b406519ebe12c21b2aadc0b6e15a Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/978877 Commit-Ready: Micah Morton <mortonm@chromium.org> Tested-by: Micah Morton <mortonm@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Xiaoyong Zhou <xzhou@chromium.org>

arc-base: Add exception for symlink blocking on stateful. Symlink and FIFO access on the stateful partition are being blocked by CL:978780 for security reasons. Add an exception so that symlinks can be used in the /mnt/stateful_partition/unencrypted/art-data directory. See b/75023589 for details on the need for the exception. CQ-DEPEND=CL:978877 BUG=b:75023589 TEST=ran Android CTS tests that used to reliably trigger symlink blocking for cache file. Symlink traversal is no longer blocked. debugd: Add netstat and logcat to log_tool (chrome://system) Add netstat so that users can see open sockets. Since we are adding more and more services that listen on open ports (arc-networkd, vm_concierge, etc.) this can be useful to troubleshoot why a Chrome app is unable to bind to a port. log_tool already shows ps and ifconfig, so there is precedent for offering this level of information. Add logcat to aid in debugging Android issues when the user does not have shell access. BUG=none TEST=manually visit chrome://system TEST=`dbus-send --reply-timeout=30000 --system --print-reply --fixed \ --dest=org.chromium.debugd /org/chromium/debugd \ org.chromium.debugd.GetFeedbackLogs` Change-Id: I2fae76bd43c4bad0f333d2c8bfebdf5556bd0e23 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/972356 Commit-Ready: Kevin Cernekee <cernekee@chromium.org> Tested-by: Kevin Cernekee <cernekee@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Mike Frysinger <vapier@chromium.org>
